label: Gumroad
terms_note: Automation allowed (OAuth app from Settings › Advanced, scopes edit_products / view_sales / …); free; rate limit undocumented (429 → back off)

auth: 1. Tenant signs in to Gumroad → **Settings › Advanced › Applications** → *Create application* (name, redirect URI).
2. *Generate access token* on that application → a non-expiring bearer for the user's own account (what the vault stores
4. Token lifetime: the dashboard-generated token does not expire until revoked; OAuth tokens per Doorkeeper config.

reference.limits: Not published; the API returns 429 — exponential back-off, prefer webhooks (`resource_subscriptions`) over polling. - Automation is allowed and expected (public OAuth API, official CLI "designed for humans and AI agents alike"). - No partner gate, no fee for API use; Gumroad is the seller of record and collects 10 % + $0.50 per sale (30 % via Discover). - Content policy applies to what is listed (Gumroad ToS); adult flag via `is_adult`.
mcp_sdk: Community MCP (read / enable / disable / offer codes only, no create or upload): https://github.com/rmarescu/gumroad-mcp

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Gumroad access token (Settings > Advanced > Applications > Create application > Generate access token; scopes view_profile, edit_products, view_sales, edit_sales) sent as Authorization: Bearer. The API page's curl examples pass the same token as the access_token parameter instead.

adapter.terms: Gumroad is the seller of record (10 % + 50¢ per sale, 30 % via Discover); rate limit undocumented (429 → back off).

me.note: GET /user (view_profile) returns {success, user{bio, name, twitter_handle, user_id, email (view_sales scope), url, profile_picture_url}}.

list_products.note: GET /products returns ALL of the account's products unpaged: {success, products[{id, name, description, price (INTEGER in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 100 = $1.00), currency (lowercase, e.g. usd), published, deleted, short_url, thumbnail_url, sales_count, ...}]}. `page`/`limit`/`status` are not sent (ignore next_page); published/deleted are booleans in raw, so `status` is null; created/updated timestamps are not returned.

get_product.note: GET /products/:id returns {success, product{...}} with the same fields as list_products; `price` is an integer in the smallest currency unit and `status` is null (see raw.published / raw.deleted).

create_product.note: POST /products {name, description (HTML), price (required; INTEGER in the smallest currency unit — pass 1000 for $10.00), price_currency_type (ISO code, defaults to the account currency), draft: true} (edit_products scope) saves an UNPUBLISHED DRAFT digital product; publish it with PUT /products/:id/enable (not mapped). `url` is not accepted (custom_permalink is a slug, files/covers are separate uploads).

update_price.note: PUT /products/:id {price (INTEGER in the smallest currency unit, e.g. 1000 for $10.00), price_currency_type} sends only those fields (edit_products scope). Not allowed for tiered memberships (tier prices are variants). Returns the updated product.

list_sales.note: GET /sales?after=since (DATE in the form YYYY-MM-DD; a datetime is not documented)&product_id (view_sales scope) lists successful sales, newest first: {success, next_page_key, sales[{id, email, product_id, product_name, price (INTEGER, smallest currency unit), currency, created_at, order_id, refunded, partially_refunded, chargedback, disputed, paid, license_key, ...}]}. Paging is by page_key/next_page_key, which page/limit cannot carry: `page` and `limit` are not sent and only the first page (raw next_page_key for the rest) is returned; `status` is null.

refund.note: DESTRUCTIVE: PUT /sales/:id/refund {amount_cents} (edit_sales scope) refunds the sale in FULL when `amount` is omitted, or partially by `amount` — which is sent as amount_cents, i.e. an INTEGER in the minor units of the sale's `currency` (200 = 2.00 USD/EUR/...; JPY has no minor unit, so 200 = ¥200). Multiple partial refunds are allowed until fully refunded. `reason` is not accepted. Returns {success, sale{... refunded, partially_refunded}}; `amount` is the sale price, `status` is null.

not_offered.get_sales_stats: The public API reference documents only per-sale records (GET /sales, GET /sales/:id) and per-product sales_count / sales_usd_cents on GET /products; no revenue-totals endpoint is documented there.
not_offered.list_refunds: No refunds endpoint: refunds and chargebacks are the refunded, partially_refunded, chargedback and disputed flags on the GET /sales rows (filter list_sales client-side).
